heading: Investment of the Fund
lead: Money in the Fund not required for current disbursements may be invested and reinvested by the Secretary of the Treasury in interest-bearing obligations of the United States or in obligations guaranteed as to both principal and interest by the United States.

notes.text: Amendments1991—Pub. L. 102–40 renumbered section 5228 of this title as this section.
